notes:
Presentational restyle of the customer TRACKING screen states onto the shared UI kit (UC-020 WI-4). All hooks, the status->phase mapping (headlineRules.ts), and every data flow are unchanged. TrackingSheet: per-phase content rebuilt from the kit -- searching (SearchingLoader + NEW searchingHint caption + order-code Pill tone neutral, via a new optional `code` prop threaded from TrackingPage), assigned (DriverCard + neutral Callout composing watchFor when vehicle-colour+plate BOTH exist and paymentNote when price exists), arrived (success Pill 'Na místě' + Plate size lg 48px, falling back to the vehicle line when plate absent), inProgress (info Pill 'Probíhá' + dropoff + price), completed (check Icon + headline + injected RatingForm slot), cancelled (close Icon + headline + reorder link). Headline stays an aria-live=polite

heading with the SAME i18n keys -- all e2e heading contracts preserved. CancelDialog converted from a centred modal to the shared BottomSheet action sheet (role=dialog aria-label from customer.tracking.cancelDialogTitle => name 'Zrušit objednávku?' survives; danger 'Ano, zrušit' + secondary 'Ne, ponechat' kit Buttons; accepted-warning kept as a warning Callout; Escape->onDismiss). RatingForm: LOCAL StarPicker swapped for the shared kit StarPicker (48px SVG stars) wiring starsLegend/starLabel; comment textarea + submit restyled with kit Button; local StarPicker.tsx deleted (grep confirmed only RatingForm imported it). PushPrompt restyled as a top-anchored floating surface card (kit Button + bell Icon) with identical feature-detect logic. No new i18n keys added -- only the pre-provisioned keys (searchingHint, pillArrived, pillInProgress, watchFor, paymentNote) were consumed. All new styling uses CSS vars. WATCHFOR BUG FIXED (advisor catch, RED->GREEN): the {{vehicle}} slot must be the car descriptor (vm.vehicleColor), NOT the color-plate composite -- the composite doubled the plate into both {{vehicle}} and {{plate}} ('Sledujte vozidlo cerna . 1AB 2345, SPZ 1AB 2345'); and the gate is now vm.vehicleColor && vm.vehiclePlate (was Boolean(composite && plate) which fired the line with a plate-only VM). Two failing-first tests pin the exact string + the colour-absent omission. RatingForm thanks-branch aria-label on a

removed (aria-prohibited-attr family, redundant with the visible text) + a new axe test covers the read-only thanks state. Added per-phase axe assertions (searching/assigned/arrived/completed + open cancel sheet) and the CancelDialog keeps its own axe test. Scoped vitest 113 passed, eslint --max-warnings 0 exit 0. Project-wide `tsc --noEmit` reports ONE error in web/src/features/customer/order/OptionsSheet.test.tsx (a concurrent lane's untracked WIP -- OptionsSheet.tsx/.test.tsx exist untracked in the mixed-lane tree); ZERO tracking-scope tsc errors -- my files are type-clean. git add limited to the tracking files + the deletion; nothing committed.
reported_gaps: Shared kit StarPicker has NO readOnly mode (the deleted local StarPicker had one). The RatingForm 'thanks' (already-rated) state no longer renders a star glyph row -- it renders the thanks text plus an accessible 'Vaše hodnocení: N z 5' line (customer.rating.yourRating). No test required visible stars in the thanks state, but if the design wants a read-only star display in the thanks state, the shared StarPicker needs a readOnly prop (kit change, out of this WI's scope).

TrackingPage meta-states (expired / login-needed / loading centred surfaces) were left on the legacy theme.colors tokens -- they are NOT order-status phases (per the file's own comment) and were not in the WI's per-phase restyle bullets. Their heading/call-fallback e2e contracts are untouched. A follow-up could migrate them to the kit if desired.

assigned-phase watchFor Callout and the DriverCard both surface the plate + vehicle-colour (by design: DriverCard is the identity card, the Callout is the 'what to look for' hint). The pre-existing TrackingSheet test that asserted a SINGLE occurrence of the plate/colour was updated to getAllByText(...).length > 0 to match the intended redesign.
